device.description: 10-bit 40 MSPS pipelined ADC with internal reference and tri-state CMOS parallel outputs
device.note: ads821.pdf (SBAS040B) p.2-3 specifications (logic levels, SOB/BTC selectable, 3-state enable 40 ns / disable 10 ns max, +VS 4.75-5.25 V), p.4 pin configuration and descriptions, timing diagram (t2 new data delay 12.5 ns max after the rising clock edge, 6.5-clock latency), p.10 digital output data (SOB, BTC with MSBI pin 19 high, OE pin 18 high = Hi-Z), Table I coding

pages: p.2-3 (specifications), p.4 (pinout, pin descriptions, timing diagram: t2 12.5 ns), p.10 (digital output data, MSBI, OE, Table I)
notModeled: analog input, internal references (REFT/REFB bypass, CM output); the result is always the 0 V differential (bipolar zero) code: 200h straight offset binary, 000h with MSBI high
pipeline latency of 6.5 clock cycles (the code is constant)
clock period / duty-cycle limits (25 ns to 100 us, tH 13 ns min for no missing codes at high rates) and aperture delay
3-state enable time (40 ns max) differs from the disable time (10 ns); tFloat uses the disable time; the datasheet says OE is for test only, not for driving a bus
internal pull-down resistors on OE and MSBI (floating reads low)
pin 27 is the complementary input (IN with an overbar in the datasheet); both inputs are named IN
pins 12 and 13 are DNC (do not connect)
variants: ADS821 only (ADS820 is the 20 MSPS sibling in its own datasheet, same pinout)
